segments.contextAfter: `owner`: The object to receive the requested mouse-tracking, mouse-moved, or cursor-update messages. It does not necessarily have to be the view associated with the created `NSTrackingArea` object, but should be an object capable of responding to the `NSResponder` methods [`mouseEntered(with:)`](nsresponder/mouseentered(with:).md), [`mouseExited(with:)`](nsresponder/mouseexited(with:).md), [`mouseMoved(with:)`](nsresponder/mousemoved(with:).md), and [`cursorUpdate(with:)`](nsresponder/cursorupdate(with:).md).
